name: Astronomy
tagline: Ever stared at the sky and needed answers? This one's for you.
description: Study celestial mechanics, astrophysics, and observational techniques to prepare for IOAA and national astronomy challenges.

district.label: Entry (scored application, 10 marks)
district.honestNote: There is no district round. The entry stage is a scored application file worth 10 marks (motivation statement 5 + SEE/BLE 5) — the only Nepali olympiad that grades the application.

national.label: National Round + Closed Camp
national.officialName: NAO Stage 2 (National Round) + Stage 3 (Final Round / Closed Camp, 7 days)

rounds.name: NAO Provincial Round (Entrance Exam)
rounds.marking: No negative marking. The scored application file adds 10 marks: motivation statement 5 + SEE (Senior) / last final exam (Junior) 5
rounds.eligibility: Nepali citizens; Senior = classes 11–12 (born after 1 July 2006 for NAO2026); Junior = classes 8–10 (born after 1 July 2010)
rounds.registration: NRs 1,000 (non-refundable); 50% waiver with a local-government letter citing financial situation + academic excellence; deadline ≈ mid-January
rounds.centres: 7 centres — one per province; coordinators published by NASO

source.label: NAO2025 Guidelines + official NAO Senior/Junior syllabus PDFs

rounds.name: NAO National Round (Stage 2)
rounds.format: Assignments, projects and basic data-analysis tasks; small reports; simple observational tools such as paper telescopes
rounds.marking: Emphasis on understanding, originality and clarity rather than competition

rounds.name: NAO Final Round — Closed Camp (Stage 3)
rounds.format: 7-day national closed camp: theoretical tests + data analysis (mean, median, regression, error estimation) + observational astronomy (often paper-based); follows the IOAA syllabus structure; lectures + mock exams

dates.label: NAO2026 National Merit Lists published (40 Senior + 40 Junior)

rounds.name: IOAA
rounds.format: Theory (300 marks) + Data Analysis (150) + Observation: Telescope (50) · Sky Map (50) · Planetarium (50) + Group round — 600 marks total
rounds.eligibility: Top Senior merit-list students; final selection includes interviews with students and their parents

dates.label: 19th IOAA 2026 — Hanoi, Vietnam (Nepal: 5 students, HM — Pratyush Poudel)

rounds.name: OWAO (Open World Astronomy Olympiad)
rounds.eligibility: Selected from the national merit list

rounds.name: IAO (International Astronomy Olympiad)
rounds.eligibility: Selected from the national merit list

rounds.name: APAO (Asian-Pacific Astronomy Olympiad)
rounds.eligibility: As per the invitation received from the organisers
